summary: Frontend-only verification of Fotuber Digital Invitation catalog + reveal engine (FAZ 1). Guest view at /davetiye/ahmet-yasemin-9a66eb loads WITHOUT sticking on spinner: invitation-reveal + reveal-open-btn mount, tapping the button plays the reveal and invitation-view/invitation-preview/rsvp-card render; RSVP submission (name+surname, yes) succeeds. Wizard at /davetiye-olustur: open-template-gallery opens template-gallery with all 7 category tabs (dugun/nisan/kina/nikah/bride/sunnet/kurumsal); switching to kina shows tpl-card-kina-bordo; İncele opens tpl-inspect-modal with the template visual (dark bg + particle canvas), and 'Bu Şablonla Devam Et' (tpl-inspect-use) selects it and closes the gallery; welcome-text edits reflect immediately in the live invitation-preview; Açılış Animasyonunu Önizle (preview-reveal-btn) opens reveal-preview-modal, invitation-reveal + reveal-open-btn render, and after opening reveal-mute + reveal-skip controls appear; preview-close closes the modal. No page/JS runtime errors from the new components; the only console errors observed are two 401s (unauthenticated /api/me style probes) unrelated to this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: TemplateReveal unmounts on finish so reveal-mute/reveal-skip are only visible during the open→finish window; acceptable per spec but the ~1.5–3s reveal window can be missed if a test waits too long — consider a small dev-only delay or persistent skip control near the end of the animation.

InvitationCreate.jsx is a large single file (~650 lines) mixing wizard steps, catalog modal, reveal preview modal, and payment gate; consider splitting the catalog picker + reveal preview into sub-components for maintainability.

Guest view console shows two 401 errors from an auth probe on a public page — cheap fix: only call the /api/me (or similar) probe when a session token is present, to keep the guest page console clean.
test_credentials: admin@fotuber.com.tr / FTB.2024 (not needed for these public flows)
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded invitation slug ahmet-yasemin-9a66eb (kina-bordo).
